name: Jin Haihai
source:
Soldier of the Central Empire who was evading courtships of the Emperror Xiu. She was outstanding admiral from the Blue Faction.

[spoiler]After she was captured by Japan she became an admiral of Japanese Fleet.[/spoiler]

Sometimes stands in hallways without saying anything and can't help but scare people. It seems she thinks, that in past live she was a clay figurine buried in the emperor's tomb.
